# Power

Reboot or shut down the host. `osapi behavior get --name power` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

| Description | Reboot or shut down the host |

## Method reboot

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | reboot                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Description | Reboot the host                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Detail      | Runs shutdown -r -- +N, with N the delay in whole minutes and at least one, so the agent can answer before the host goes down. A message goes to the logged-in users. Each run changes the host. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/power/reboot                                                                                                                                                      |
| Permission  | power:execute                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Command     | [osapi client node power reboot](../../../usage/cli/client/node/power/reboot.md)                                                                                                                 |
| Input type  | Input                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                           |

### Input (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS | DESCRIPTION                                                                  |
| ------- | ------- | -------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| delay   | integer | no       | min 0       | Seconds before the host goes down. It rounds to whole minutes, at least one. |
| message | string  | no       |             | A message to the logged-in users first.                                      |

### Output (3)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                             |
| ------- | ------- | --------------------------------------- |
| action  | string  | reboot or shutdown                      |
| delay   | integer | Seconds before the host goes down.      |
| changed | boolean | Always true: each run changes the host. |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                         | INPUT                          | OUTPUT                                 |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| In one minute                   | (none)                         | action=reboot, delay=60, changed=true  |
| In five minutes, with a message | delay=300, message=maintenance | action=reboot, delay=300, changed=true |
